title: /compact with a focus keeps what was named, and the chat carries on
source: Owner (2026-11-26): add /compact [focus]. Claude Code, Grok Build and Hermes all take a focus after it.

chat.label: launch
chat.goal: Work through the product launch plan with the bot over several turns: positioning line, the three pricing tiers, the launch date, and the press list. Then wander into side topics (a tagline brainstorm, a tweet thread outline) so the chat gets long.
chat.opener: lets plan the launch. pricing is 3 tiers: starter $9, team $29, scale $99 per month. press list: maya at techpulse, owen at the ledger, rhea at saasweekly. launch date 3 feb. start w a positioning line

chat.label: compact
chat.goal: Compact the chat, keeping the pricing tiers and the press list.
chat.opener: /compact keep the pricing tiers and the press list exactly

chat.label: after
chat.goal: Ask for the three price points and who is on the press list, to paste into a doc.
chat.opener: paste-ready: the 3 price points + who's on the press list

judge: After Juniper compacts the chat asking to keep the pricing tiers and the press list, the bot gives the exact tiers (Starter $9, Team $29, Scale $99 a month) and the press list (Maya at TechPulse, Owen at The Ledger, Rhea at SaaSWeekly) straight away.
